Name: Make Sebastian Noctis
Author: DiStri
Description:
Got a request for this and had been sitting on it for a long time. Sorry about that! Here he is, Noctis... the cigarette smokin', motorcycle lovin', keyboard playin' prince he never was, but probably wanted to be!

His head was very hard for me to figure out; the pixels didn't want to cooperate when it came to his eyes, so he looks perpetually sleepy. His head is also a tiny bit smaller than the other characters'. If anyone wants to take a stab at fixing up his head to look a little more compliant with Stardew standards, I'd be very grateful!!

Now Content Patcher compatible!

[b]How to Install[/b]:

Be sure to have SMAPI and Content Patcher installed. Just unzip the file and slap the [b][CP] Make Seb Noctis[/b] folder into your Mods folder. Enjoy!

Don't hesitate to contact me if you have issues getting the sprites to work. Thanks!

Downloads.Description: An updated Content Patcher version of the old xnb file replacement.
